correct.evidence: All SPEC-named inputs right: five acceptance and three holdout point 17 twins by hand, withdrawal view opens unchosen, samples made and checked by make.py (planted drift caught), heading text compared. Beside them: a 2020 petition still removes grace.p2 and raises cap_gap.h9.ends_before_starts; P1 (filed during OPT, start inside the card) shows validations after the pack's own end of F-1 status; /welcome, / and /updates can never pass the shot text check.

sourced.evidence: tools.sources.verify and plain exit 0; capgap.status_ends_on_h1b_start note says how point 17 uses it. The filed-on filter applies (f)(12)(ii)(B) narrower than the pack's own end-of-status reading (P1).

never_assumes.evidence: An approved change-of-status petition with no filed_on (or no validity_start) is read as not belonging, with no question; a conflict is invented for an old petition on a record that holds none.

inside_the_boundary.evidence: No new string states a conclusion about a person; the invented conflict reads as 'Two documents disagree on ...' (status.ts:65), untrue of the record.

secure.evidence: No new outside input beyond the samples test spawning a fixed uv command; twenty journeys, eight twins, eight probes and three walked cases all 200.

tested.evidence: Mutants m1 (filed_on >= card_start) and m3 (cos_ended_on) caught; m4 (approved filter removed) passes acceptance and holdout; no test for grace or cap_gap with an old petition; no test compares a real screen heading with its landmark.

findings.title: An old approved change-of-status petition removes the grace and invents a cap-gap conflict
findings.input: J19 plus h9 {h1b, change_of_status yes, approved, filed_on 2020-04-01, validity_start 2020-10-01} (acceptance twin of point 17)
findings.what_happens: grace.p2 2028-06-09 to 2028-08-07 disappears; cap_gap.h9 runs 2028-06-09 to 2020-10-01 with conflict and question cap_gap.h9.ends_before_starts, read to the person as two documents disagreeing.

findings.title: 'Filed while the card runs' leaves out a petition filed during the first OPT with its start inside the STEM card
findings.input: J19 plus h9 {h1b, cap_subject yes, change_of_status yes, approved, filed_on 2026-04-01, validity_start 2026-10-01}
findings.what_happens: Grace is dropped (F-1 read as ending 2026-10-01) yet validation_2 2027-06-09 and validation_3 2027-12-09 are shown as due in the same output. Disputed against point 17's wording.

findings.title: Shot heading check compares canvas copy the app never draws
findings.input: holdsLandmark with the app's heading ('Which visa status do you hold now?', 'Can't tell yet', 'No published update matches your status.') in each landmark's exact type
findings.what_happens: false for /welcome, / and /updates (true for /timeline); 12 of 20 planned shots can never count as drawn, so make design-shots fails every run.

findings.title: Approved filter untested; a missing filed_on is read as not belonging with no question
findings.input: (a) pack with outcome in [approved] removed, T3 with outcome denied; (b) T3 with no filed_on
findings.what_happens: (a) mutant drops validations 2 and 3 and every acceptance and holdout test passes; (b) validations 2 and 3 shown due, no h9.filed_on question, no reason.
